admin.title: Admin Console
admin.description: Run Flarum commands directly from the administration dashboard.
admin.ready: Ready. Select an action or enter an approved command.
admin.request_failed: Request failed. Check the server log.
admin.confirm:
Run this command with the forum user's permissions?

{command}
admin.crypto_required: The console requires a browser with cryptographic random number support.
admin.unconfirmed: No confirmed completion. Reload to retrieve the saved status. Do not install again.
admin.queued: Saved. Waiting for the background service.
admin.opcache_failed: Web OPcache could not be fully refreshed.
admin.job_failed: Job {status} (exit {code}). See the output. If interrupted, inspect it in the terminal first.
admin.warnings: The process returned exit 0, but its output contains warnings. Please review it.
admin.poll_failed: Status retrieval interrupted: {error} The saved job is not cancelled. Reload the page.
admin.admin_check_failed: The cache command finished, but the admin page follow-up failed. Check the Flarum log.
admin.admin_check_unavailable: The cache command finished; the admin page could not be checked afterwards.
admin.composer_require: Install an extension — replace the package name
admin.composer_remove: Remove an extension — replace the package name
admin.picker_help: Commands are read from this installation. Actions outside the allowlist insert a help command.
admin.help_only: Show help · Run in the terminal
admin.worker_missing: The background service is not reporting. Check its setup; saved jobs are retained.
admin.command_help: Replace placeholders such as {extension} or {package} before running. Approved commands only; no shell chaining.
admin.history_help: Commands, results and output are stored privately. Completed jobs are deleted at the next worker sweep after seven days or beyond 100 entries. Package snapshots are retained.
admin.worker_help: Commands run in a separate worker. You can close this page and retrieve the status later. Do not perform other maintenance through SSH or Portainer during package changes. If Flarum will not start, use the server terminal.
admin.error_input_invalid: Command too long or contains unsupported control characters.
admin.error_composer_usage: Composer: show [package], require package[:version], or remove package.
admin.error_protected_packages: The console and Flarum core cannot be changed here.
admin.error_self_disable: The running console cannot disable itself.
admin.error_arguments_forbidden: Additional arguments are not allowed for this command.
admin.error_package_invalid: Invalid package name or version constraint. Example: vendor/package:^2.0
admin.error_catalog_unreadable: The command catalog could not be read.
admin.error_worker_uid: The worker must run as an identifiable PHP user, never as root.
admin.error_acknowledge_invalid: Only interrupted jobs can be acknowledged.
admin.error_uid_mismatch: The worker UID does not match the web PHP user.
admin.error_job_interrupted: Job interrupted; do not start more jobs.
admin.error_backup_create: The snapshot could not be created. Package changes were not started.
admin.error_extension_list_missing: The existing extension list is missing. Package changes were not started.
admin.error_folder_symlink: The console directory must not be a symbolic link.
admin.error_folder_unwritable: The console directory is not writable.
admin.error_lock_open: The lock file cannot be opened.
admin.error_job_id_used: This job ID is already in use.
admin.error_queue_busy: A job is already open. Check its status; resolve interrupted jobs in the terminal first.
admin.error_job_corrupt: The job file is damaged. No automatic retry.
admin.error_cleanup_failed: Expired job output could not be deleted.
admin.error_target_symlink: A symbolic link cannot be used as the target file.
admin.error_state_create: The status file cannot be created.
admin.error_state_write: The status file could not be written completely.
admin.error_state_replace: The status file cannot be replaced atomically.
admin.error_web_uid: The web PHP user must be identifiable and must not be root.
admin.error_worker_root: Do not run the worker as root. Use the same user as PHP-FPM.
admin.error_worker_paths: Storage/public paths are missing. For a custom site.php, specify --storage and --public.
admin.error_worker_busy: The worker is still busy. Inspect the running job first.
admin.error_command_forbidden: This command is not allowed. Available actions: {commands}.
admin.error_interrupted_pending: Interrupted job {id}: inspect processes and package state before using --acknowledge.
admin.error_backup_copy: Snapshot of {file} failed. Package changes were not started.
admin.worker_lost: The worker ended without confirmed completion. A child process may still be running. Inspect it in the terminal; no automatic retry.
